scope_change_source: user-approved explicit paired fast-forward-only merge recommendation

scenario_confirmation_interactions.question: Should Meta Flow add an explicit merge operation after publish?
scenario_confirmation_interactions.recommendation: explicit paired fast-forward-only merge with separate authorization
scenario_confirmation_interactions.confirmed_understanding: Publish remains push-only. Merge is a separate operation, preflights both repositories, runs artifact then project, never creates a merge commit or uses rebase/force/conflict resolution, retains both CR branches on partial failure, and requires explicit default-branch-write authorization.
